concepts.name: NDA effective date
justifications: The agreement states that the Effective Date is 1 February 2027, distinct from the signing date of 29 January 2027.

concepts.name: NDA permitted purpose
predicted: minority investment evaluation by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch
gold: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
values: Minority investment evaluation by the Recipient in the Discloser's marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch
justifications: The sole Permitted Purpose is evaluating a possible minority investment in the marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch. Competing business, product development, unrelated acquisition evaluation and machine-learning training are excluded.

concepts.name: NDA disclosure window end
justifications: A valid termination notice delivered on 24 November 2027 closes the disclosure window effective 30 November 2027, which overrides the ordinary end date of 31 January 2028.

concepts.name: NDA contractual forum
justifications: The parties designate the courts of Oslo as their contractual forum, with Norwegian law governing the agreement.

concepts.name: NDA signatory entities
justifications: FjordSignal AS is registered in Norway and is identified as the Discloser party to the agreement.
Talus Ventures AB is registered in Sweden and is identified as the Recipient party to the agreement.

concepts.name: Protected assets at the April snapshot
justifications: At the 7 April 2027 snapshot, LUMEN, SHORE, CEDAR and BASALT remain Confidential Information. ORACLE lapsed after its late confirmation, MICA is excluded by independent development, and each remaining asset has no complete exclusion.

concepts.name: ORACLE timely confirmation deadline
justifications: Five Business Days after the 25 March 2027 oral disclosure, skipping the excluded 26 and 29 March, ends on 5 April 2027 at 17:00 UTC.

concepts.name: ORACLE protection timeline
predicted: protection is not continuous. the oral information was provisionally protected from the 25 march 2027 disclosure until the 5 april 2027 17:00 utc deadline. the confirmation was sent at 16:58 on 5 april but arrived after the cut-off and is treated as delivered on 6 april at 09:00 utc, so provisional protection ended at the deadline. written acceptance on 8 april at 10:00 utc restored protection only prospectively, leaving a gap from 5 april 17:00 utc to 8 april 10:00 utc; the sending date did not count, only delivery.
gold: oracle is provisionally protected from the 25 march oral disclosure until 5 april 2027 at 17:00 utc. confirmation sent before that deadline arrived late on 6 april at 09:05, so protection lapses after the deadline. it resumes prospectively when the recipient expressly accepts on 8 april at 10:00 utc; the gap is not cured retroactively.
values: Protection is not continuous. The oral information was provisionally protected from the 25 March 2027 disclosure until the 5 April 2027 17:00 UTC deadline. The confirmation was sent at 16:58 on 5 April but arrived after the cut-off and is treated as delivered on 6 April at 09:00 UTC, so provisional protection ended at the deadline. Written acceptance on 8 April at 10:00 UTC restored protection only prospectively, leaving a gap from 5 April 17:00 UTC to 8 April 10:00 UTC; the sending date did not count, only delivery.
justifications: The confirmation was delivered late, so protection lapsed at the deadline and was restored only from acceptance. Sending time did not matter because delivery is measured at mailbox arrival.

concepts.name: Entire SHORE package excluded by prior possession
justifications: The prior-possession evidence covers only the older S-17 module, which is incorporated in S-92. The new branching map and thresholds were first received on 20 February and are not shown to be previously possessed, so the entire SHORE package is not excluded.

concepts.name: CEDAR end of protection
justifications: The Discloser independently and lawfully released the entire CEDAR schedule to the public on 15 June 2027, which establishes the public-information exclusion and ends protection of that information as soon as it is established. The later September resend did not restart protection.

concepts.name: People permitted LUMEN access at the September snapshot
justifications: Elin, Marek and Oskar each meet their applicable role, undertaking or professional-duty, security check, and clean-room requirements effective by the 15 September 2027 snapshot. Marek's Talus Research employment qualifies because the Recipient's combined direct and proxy votes exceed 50 percent there.

concepts.name: Talus Research qualifying voting percentage
justifications: The Recipient's 48 percent directly held general votes plus the 4 percent covered by a presently effective irrevocable proxy, which is in force at the snapshot, total 52 percent. The revocable 6 percent and the non-voting preference shares are excluded.

concepts.name: Marek earliest authorised LUMEN access
justifications: Marek's employment at Talus Research qualifies once his clean-room approval becomes effective on 14 September, which is later than his undertaking (8 September) and security check (10 September). The proposed 9 September access date is not permitted.

concepts.name: Executed competitor consent date for Pia
Q-27 notice deadline date
justifications: Initially prohibited notice must arrive by the earlier of six continuous hours after the prohibition is lifted (11:20 on 5 July 2027, giving 17:20) and the production time. The 17:20 on 5 July 2027 deadline is earlier than the 12:00 on 6 July 2027 production time.

concepts.name: Q-27 notice lateness in minutes
justifications: The notice reached the designated mailbox at 17:55 on 5 July 2027, against a deadline of 17:20 that day, and the after-hours deferral does not apply to initially prohibited notices. The difference is 35 whole minutes.

concepts.name: Q-27 permitted production units
justifications: The final binding narrowing order requires all of P1 and only the non-privileged subsection P3A, with P3B identified as privileged and P2 and P4 withdrawn. These are therefore the only production units permitted under the final scope.

concepts.name: WORK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The restored WORK-1 working copy keeps the original ten-Business-Day deadline, which ran from the return request delivered on 22 November 2027 and was not restarted by the 1 December restoration. Excluding the weekend and the 25 and 26 November exclusions, the tenth Business Day is 8 December 2027.

concepts.name: BK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The immutable backup may remain only until the earlier of its next scheduled overwrite and 45 calendar days after the return trigger, and restoration does not restart either clock. The scheduled overwrite on 30 December 2027 falls before the 45-day limit of 6 January 2028.

concepts.name: Artifacts permitted retention at the December snapshot
justifications: ARCH-1 is the single counsel-held archive permitted under the archival exception, and BK-1 remains within its disaster-recovery backup window at the snapshot. HOLD-1 is the exact bundle under a binding preservation order still in force at the snapshot.

concepts.name: NOTE-1 model training permitted as residual knowledge
justifications: Residual-knowledge permission excludes recorded notes and quantitative parameters, and model training with such material is prohibited without a separate signed licence. NOTE-1 is a deliberately recorded parameter and reconstruction note, and no licence or consent covers its use for training.
